question: A student needs to select a metal for a photoelectric device that operates using visible light (Photon energies range from approx $1.8 \text{ eV}$ to $3.1 \text{ eV}$). Given the work functions: Platinum ($5.65 \text{ eV}$), Aluminum ($4.28 \text{ eV}$), and Potassium ($2.30 \text{ eV}$), which metal is the only suitable candidate?
